head: 9d8d784a3293da96db6cc36f508c49449a0333ac
claim: a person can open Add an account, tap DeepSeek and connect a pasted key on the shared key form, which says it is charged per use and then lists the key under Your keys

steps.start: a fresh browser profile on the example PWA at 390 px, light then dark
steps: open Add an account and see every ready key route tappable, per-use ones labelled as charged per use
tap DeepSeek, see the key form with its billing line and hidden typing
paste a made-up key and Connect
see the key under Your keys with its billing
steps.result: the key is listed under Your keys as charged per use to the DeepSeek account; no route waits under Coming soon

verdicts.seen: The outcome names the DeepSeek key form and the Your keys list. The screen shows the DeepSeek "paste a key" card with "Charged per use to your DeepSeek account" and "Your key is ready." Below it, under "Your keys," the entry "DeepSeek" is listed with "Charged per use to your DeepSeek account" and a Remove link. This matches the outcome.
